Definition: a push, i.e. (by implication) a fall
BiblicalUsage: The word appears twice, both times for the stumbling foot: the psalmist's feet slipping toward the grave, and the Lord keeping his feet from falling. A push is a small thing, and a fall is a great one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is the prayer of everyone who has felt the ground give way: keep my feet, Lord, for I cannot keep them myself.
